cohort: 42 pregnant women with Eisenmenger syndrome admitted to the Beijing Anzhen Hospital between 2010 and 2019
finding: Pregnant women with Eisenmenger syndrome experienced high rates of complications, including pulmonary hypertensive crisis, maternal mortality, and neonatal mortality, highlighting the significant risks associated with pregnancy in this population.
mod_finding: 95.2% of the women had cesarean delivery, but the study does not specifically analyze its impact on outcomes.
